captions_note: built with CAPTIONS=0, so the reel's own captions run straight through the transition
in_a_reel: make the slot ACROSS the cut: --from about 0.5 s before it, --to about 0.5 s after it (the move is 18 frames centred on the cut, each side needs at least 11 frames). fx_new.py --project records the cut frame, the words and the cutout by itself: do not run two_shot.py
set CREEP_A = 1 and CREEP_B = 1 (the slot must hand back unmoved footage at both edges) and leave GRADE_A / GRADE_B at None
after the reel render, look at every frame of the move: frames_check.py --at with 6 to 8 times from 0.3 s before the cut to 0.3 s after it

outside a reel (two separate files): fx_new.py zoom-through-cut <slot> --src <shot A> --in <sec> --frames <N> --no-cutout --no-transcribe, then fx_run.py <slot> two_shot.py --src <shot B> --in <sec> --frames <N>
steps: run prep.py      # measure, then LOOK at work/measure.jpg (yellow cross on dark flat fabric, green line under the speaker's chin)
edit the CLIP block in build.py (caption words and times from words.json, points only if the cross is wrong)
run bake.py sheet      # bake: half-size contact sheet first (about 30s), full bake when it looks right (2 to 4 min); look at work/bake/sheet.jpg
run build.py SAFE=1 CAPTIONS=0      # compose, check, render
hf snapshot --at <6 to 8 times incl. the frames around the cut>
